name: CSE 5102
title: Advanced Programming Languages
description: The theory and pragmatics of modern programming languages. Topics include syntax, semantics, type systems and control mechanisms. Key contributions from Functional and Logic Programming including first-order functions, closures, continuations, non-determinism and unification are studied. Study of declarative and operational semantics of recent entries in the field like Constraint Programming and Aspect Oriented Programming.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in the CSE program, others with consent. Recommended preparation: CSE 4102 and 3502 or the equivalent.
